letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. The gentle hum of the city and the soft rustle of monsoon breezes both whisper your name, and my heart skips a beat thinking of our laugh‑filled evenings together. You’re my forever cutie, the sparkle in my coffee, the calm in my storms. I love you more with each passing day, and can’t wait for our next adventure, hand in hand.
poem:
In desert dunes or monsoon rain,  
Your smile lights my world again.  
Together we dance, love’s sweet tune,  
Forever yours, beneath the same moon.
